description: Save critical ext2/ext3/ext4 file system metadata to an image file.

option.name: -a
tip: Include file data in the image file.

option.name: -b
tip: Use the superblock at this file system block number.

option.name: -B
tip: Set the file system block size in bytes.

option.name: -c
tip: Compare each copied block with the corresponding block in the target image.

option.name: -f
tip: Override the read-only requirement when saving an image.

option.name: -I
tip: Install the metadata stored in the image back to the device.

option.name: -n
tip: Only print the block numbers that would be written.

option.name: -o
tip: Read the image at this byte offset from the source device.

option.name: -O
tip: Write the image at this byte offset in the target file.

option.name: -p
tip: Show progress while creating the image file.

option.name: -s
tip: Scramble directory entries and zero unused directory block space.
